    - list:
      - listitem: Agent products where several tasks run in the background and people come back to see what finished, what failed and what waits for them
      - listitem: A home screen or dashboard that collects approvals from many runs in one calm board, instead of one modal per agent
      - listitem: Job queues in general – imports, syncs, evaluations – where each job has a short description, a short history and one next step
    - heading "When not to use" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: One single approval in the flow of a chat – use Approval Card
      - listitem: The plan of one run, step by step – use Agent Plan; for a single tool call use Tool Call Card
      - listitem: Hundreds of jobs – the board is for a few dozen at most; page or search a bigger queue in a table
